_comment: ADR-0370 U6 per-route budgets, measured 2026-11-11 on the production build. jsBytes = decoded client JS the route loads (deterministic per build), set 5% above the measurement, rounded up to 10 KiB. lcpMs = Largest Contentful Paint with an empty BFF; local LCP varied 2-3x between runs, so it is a coarse 2500 ms ceiling (Web Vitals 'good'), not a ratchet. Raise a budget only with a reason in the PR.
